candidate_profile: Candidate: entry-level (trainee / intern / junior), no commercial experience yet. Master's in Computer Science (graduating Dec 2026).
Location: Lviv, Ukraine. Prefers remote, hybrid or an office in Lviv; an office in another city is fine for a good match.
Main interests: project management / coordination, no-code & AI automation (n8n, Apps Script, APIs), user acquisition / performance marketing,
business, data or financial analysis, QA (manual first, test automation is fine too).
Also open to adjacent trainee roles where the skills overlap: data engineering / BI, product design, analyst roles that use Python.
Skills: SQL, Postman / REST APIs, Jira, Python (intermediate), Google Sheets & Apps Script, n8n, Telegram bots. English B2.
Usually not a fit: roles for experienced specialists, software engineering as the main job, sales-only roles, customer support, night shifts.
